__TOC__

Survey of 2021 (and 2019) HPS data on endeavour, made 2026-11-06.

* '''E''' = <code>/net/data/endeavour2/HPS/physrun2021</code>  (37 TB disk, network)
* '''F''' = <code>/fast/HPS</code>  (3.6 TB local NVMe on endeavour, fast)

Event counts are the MiniDST/ntuple entries. The detector was read with <code>dumpevent</code> from the first SLCIO file of
the sample (or the files it was made from). Every MiniDST has a <code>metadata_json</code> object that lists its input SLCIO file(s).

'''SVT column:''' H = SVT hits (<code>svt_hit_*</code>), T = per-hit MC truth (<code>svt_hit_mc_part_idx</code>), R = raw strip hits
(<code>svt_raw_hit_*</code>, amplitude/t0/χ²), raw = readout-level LCIO, sim = SLIC output, – = no SVT hit branches
(tracks only).

'''* Detector inferred''' from the pass5_v9 production path in <code>metadata_json</code>: the input SLCIO files are at JLab
(<code>/lustre24/expphy/cache/hallb/hps/production/...</code>), not on endeavour. "SLAC" = input recon files at SLAC (<code>/sdf/...</code>).

== Home-made MC (erbaz, Oct 2026) — best documented, latest software ==

All in <code>E/home_made_mc/</code>. Each sample has an <code>MC_INFO.md</code> with the full chain, steering, versions and reproduction configs (<code>_config/</code>). 3.74 GeV, run-14272 conditions, local SQLite conditions DB, KF tracking, recon steering <code>PhysicsRun2021MCRecon_KF_WithSpacing_pass5_physics_HitSmear_HitKill_14272</code>. Overlay samples use real 2021 pulser data; no pulser event is shared between samples.

== Notes ==

* Every MiniDST has tree <code>MiniDST</code>. <code>svt_hit_type</code> 0 and 1 are identical copies; tracks point to 1 in MC and pass5_v10, to 0 in pass5_v9 data.
* Pass6 data skims (<code>pass6_v10/data</code>) have no SVT hit collections, even in their LCIO files.
* Some overlay files lack the pulser SVT data for many events (e.g. A′ m105MeV file 0001): check the per-file mean SVT occupancy (~140 hits/event) first.
* <code>E/MC_test/run_beam*</code> is a beam-background MC test that is nearly empty; <code>E/MC_test/run_beam/work</code> holds ~140 GB of job scratch.
* <code>F/physrun2021/5percent</code> is a copy of <code>E/5percent/physics</code> (same files and size).
* Tools: <code>dumpevent <file> <n></code>, <code>lcio_event_counter</code>, <code>make_mini_dst</code> in <code>/net/home/maurik/AlmaLinux/bin</code>.
